canonical_project: Kiribati Digital Government Project (P176108) - Containerized National Data Center & Government Cloud Equipment (Phase 2)
owner: Government of Kiribati / Ministry of Information, Communications and Transport (MICT) with World Bank (IDA) financing
notes: Procurement-stage government data center + government cloud under the World Bank-financed Kiribati Digital Government Project (P176108) in South Tarawa (Gilbert Islands). World Bank Stakeholder Engagement Plan (A) states the project's only physical construction is 'the installation of a National Data Center in South Tarawa, co-located with the cable landing station or in Bairiki village' (administrative capital). World Bank 2026-03-13 procurement plan lists Phase 2 'KI-MICTTD-470992-GO-RFQ' (Containerized Data Center and Government Cloud Equipment Phase 2) as Pending Implementation (~US$900,000); tender mirrors (deepbloo, C-grade lead) show publication 14 Mar 2026 and 2026-03-31 submission deadline. MICT KDGP page (A) confirms project scope and Tarawa location. No award/delivery published as of 2026-08-12; do not count as built until commissioned.
